title: Structure-Preserving Document-Level Data Augmentation via Discourse Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2610.19497v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data augmentation (DA) plays a vital role in improving model performance in low-resource or limited-supervision scenarios within Natural Language Processing (NLP). Existing DA methods, such as synonym replacement and back-translation, have demonstrated effectiveness on the word or sentence level; however, they frequently neglect discourse-level coherence and logical flow, which are essential for complex tasks dependent on inter-sentential relationships. In this paper, we propose a structure-preserving document-level data augmentation framework based on large language models (LLMs) and document-level discourse structure parsing. Our approach identifies rhetorical relations between sentence pairs and extracts key phrases, which are then replaced with semantically coherent but topically shifted content while preserving the original discourse structure. translated_title: 基于篇章解析的结构保持型文档级数据增强
translated_abstract: 数据增强在自然语言处理（NLP）的低资源或有限监督场景下对提升模型性能起着至关重要的作用。现有的数据增强方法，如同义词替换和回译，已在词级或句子级上展现出有效性；然而，它们往往忽视篇章层面的连贯性和逻辑流程，而这些对于依赖句间关系的复杂任务至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLMs）和文档级篇章结构解析的结构保持型文档级数据增强框架。我们的方法识别句子对之间的修辞关系并提取关键短语，然后将其替换为语义连贯但主题有所偏移的内容，同时保留原始的篇章结构。在文本摘要和问答任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法
tldr: 提出了一种结合大语言模型与文档级篇章结构解析的数据增强框架，通过识别句间修辞关系并替换关键短语，在保留原文篇章结构的同时生成主题偏移的文档级增强数据，有效提升摘要与问答任务性能。
